title: Doktor KosMed public-site accessibility review
scope: Shared public-site renderer used by Vite and Nitro SSR
Public page and loading/error page landmarks
Keyboard bypass from site navigation to main content

automated_checks.coverage_note: The existing generic Axe route list does not explicitly include localized public-site catalog, doctor, service, or contact routes.

findings.observation: The shared public renderer placed the site header before the main landmark without a skip link. A localized focus-only link now targets the main landmark in both the page and loading/error renderers; the target is programmatically focusable.
findings.verification_needed: Use keyboard navigation in the built Vite and Nitro SSR pages to confirm the first Tab reveals the link and activation moves focus to the main content.

limitations: No Axe or equivalent automated scan was run.
No manual keyboard or screen-reader session was run.
This review does not assess all WCAG 2.2 AA criteria or real-device behavior.
